name: Linhenykus
sum: Alvarezsaurid from the Campanian of Inner Mongolia, the only known non-avian dinosaur with a single functional finger.
holotype: Partial skeleton from the Wulansuhai Formation near Linhe, Inner Mongolia, China (Xu et al. 2011).
material: The holotype and an articulated foot (Hone et al. 2013).
biology: Its hand kept only the enlarged first digit; the third was a reduced splint without phalanges.
author: Xu et al. 2011
